request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2, including maintenance, enhancement, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources over 12 months.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for Dolos maintenance, and the budget summary totals 540,750 ADA including a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient chain-data access without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost HTTP, UTxO-RPC gRPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros Node-to-Client Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
The Dolos GitHub project is claimed to have 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope includes dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, public communication, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states the requested amount did not, at submission, individually or in aggregate breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The proposal states independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

Intersect says it will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-like role approvals, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance grant administered by Intersect, citing open-source infrastructure value, prior Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, milestone controls, and smart-contract-based treasury administration.
